purpose: Govern progression from company mapping to company-specific, reproducible, truth-bounded technical claims without allowing portfolio presence or company naming to masquerade as second-depth proof.

default_company_state.next_gate: Verify a current public role or operating context before making any company-specific problem or implementation claim.

lockheed_martin.next_gate: Verify a current public Lockheed Martin role and team, preserve the public source, bound one externally supportable problem, then inspect only genuinely relevant GlacierEQ implementations before proposing a remedy.

openai.next_gate: Verify a current public OpenAI role/team and inspect the exact admitted KV-sentinel implementation before connecting it to any company-specific engineering problem.

anthropic.next_gate: Verify a current public Anthropic role/team, then inspect the exact promoted coordinator and safety-monitor code paths and their native proof before bounding a company-specific remedy.

nvidia.next_gate: Verify a current public NVIDIA role/team, identify one externally supportable infrastructure problem, then inspect only the governed NVIDIA-aligned repositories that could materially address it.

spacex.next_gate: Verify a current public SpaceX role/team and operating problem, then reconcile it against the governed SpaceX repository family and existing README Mesh before any implementation claim.

xai.next_gate: Verify a current public xAI role/team, select one bounded infrastructure problem, then reconcile successor/unique-value status across the Colossus repository family before any company-specific claim.

microsoft.next_gate: Verify a current public Microsoft role/team and inspect the exact recruiter-admitted Microsoft-aligned repositories before promoting beyond general systems alignment.

notion.next_gate: Verify a current public Notion role/team and inspect the exact recruiter-admitted Notion-aligned repositories before promoting beyond general platform alignment.

promotion_invariants: Stages are monotonic and may not be skipped merely because a repository is public, named for a company, or recruiter-admitted.
ROLE_VERIFIED requires preserved public role evidence; a target-role label in a dossier is not role verification.
PROBLEM_BOUNDED requires an externally supportable problem statement; speculation about proprietary bottlenecks does not qualify.
CODE_INSPECTED requires exact repository identities and inspected code paths, not README-only inference.
IMPLEMENTED requires implementation receipts tied to exact source heads.
PROOF_REPRODUCED requires a reproducible proof artifact; structural presence, test files, or prior narrative claims are insufficient by themselves.
CLAIM_PROMOTED requires an explicit claim receipt and may not exceed the strongest reproducible evidence state.

Company affiliation, endorsement, employment, proprietary access, contract relationship, clearance, adoption, production use, and measured business impact remain nonclaims unless independently evidenced.

consumer_contract.merge_rule: Resolve default_company_state first, then overlay a company_overrides entry by company_id if present.
consumer_contract.missing_override_behavior: Use the default MAPPED_ONLY state; absence of an override is never interpreted as completion.
consumer_contract.public_projection: Public consumers may expose stage, claim ceiling, blockers, next gate, and public-safe evidence references only. Private or unsupported evidence must not be surfaced.
consumer_contract.promotion_writer: Any future writer must preserve previous evidence references, append receipts rather than overwrite them, and fail closed on missing source identities or stage prerequisites.
